const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<dl><dt>Term One</dt><dd>Definition of term one.</dd><dt>Term Two</dt><dd>Definition of term two.</dd></dl>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
